cat > /app/work/perf2.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time

def run(doc, label):
    text = json.dumps(doc)
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'],
                       input=text.encode(), capture_output=True)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    o = json.loads(p.stdout)
    from collections import Counter
    dec = Counter(q["decision"] for q in o["packets"])
    st = Counter(j["status"] for j in o["jobs"])
    print("%-34s in=%5.1fMiB t=%5.2fs out=%6.1fMiB %s %s" %
          (label, len(text)/1048576, dt, len(p.stdout)/1048576, dict(dec), dict(st)))

rng = random.Random(5)
C, E, W, K, F = 8, 4, 16, 5, 8
model = {"classes": C, "embedding_dim": E,
         "length_embedding": [[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
         "gap_embedding": [[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
         "kernel": K,
         "conv_weights": [[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
         "conv_bias": [rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(F)],
         "conv_shift": [rng.choice([0,1,2,16]) for _ in range(F)],
         "dense_weights": [[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
         "dense_bias": [rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(C)]}
cfg = {"slots": 256, "window": W, "idle_timeout": 3, "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1,
       "rate_num": 10**6, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 512, "initial_tokens": 512,
       "pending_capacity": 512, "lanes": 4, "service": [1]*C, "fallback": 0,
       "time_edges": [0, 5, 100], "count_edges": [0, 3, 9],
       "probability": [[rng.choice([0, 30000, 65536]) for _ in range(3)] for _ in range(3)]}
conns = [{"id": "c%d" % i, "slot": i % 256, "label": i % C,
          "split": ("dev", "eval")[i % 2]} for i in range(2048)]
pkts = []
t = 0
for i in range(20000):
    t += rng.choice([0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 5])
    pkts.append({"time": t, "connection": "c%d" % rng.randrange(2048),
                 "length": rng.randrange(65536), "draw": rng.randrange(65536)})
run({"version": 1, "config": cfg, "model": model, "connections": conns, "packets": pkts},
    "2048 conns, collisions, resets")

# all packets at the same instant (no job can finish mid-stream)
pkts = [{"time": 0, "connection": "c%d" % (i % 64), "length": i % 65536,
         "draw": 0} for i in range(20000)]
cfg2 = dict(cfg); cfg2["idle_timeout"] = 10**12; cfg2["pending_capacity"] = 512
run({"version": 1, "config": cfg2, "model": model, "connections": conns, "packets": pkts},
    "all same timestamp")

# maximum queue pressure with slow service
pkts = [{"time": i, "connection": "c%d" % (i % 64), "length": (i*13) % 65536,
         "draw": 0} for i in range(20000)]
cfg3 = dict(cfg); cfg3["service"] = [10**6]*C; cfg3["lanes"] = 1; cfg3["idle_timeout"] = 10**12
run({"version": 1, "config": cfg3, "model": model, "connections": conns, "packets": pkts},
    "slow service, 1 lane")
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python3 perf2.py
